relations.GD1: a past or current-month day of N4 with a seed planning (HPN-19 DB cross-check)

DAY_RULES.note: month tokens are placeholders (MM1, MP1, MP2, MP13); MONTH (= M0) is generic

PLACEHOLDERS.N4_NODE: Gruppe node of Pflege Geriatrie on DM-X (Sollplan save of seed T2): KNOTEN_ID and name
PLACEHOLDERS.MM1: month before the run month, YYYY-MM
PLACEHOLDERS.MP1: month after the run month (Sollplan saved), YYYY-MM
PLACEHOLDERS.MP2: second month after the run month (no Sollplan), YYYY-MM
PLACEHOLDERS.MP13: a month beyond the roster look-ahead (e.g. run month + 13), YYYY-MM
PLACEHOLDERS.VERSION_GATE: TS-G1 result: pass | fail (HPN-19 runs only on pass; on fail it records KNOWN-FAIL HPN-K1 / BLOCKED)
PLACEHOLDERS.PORTAL_PROFILE: absolute path of the runner's portal-ops browser profile folder (outside results/)
